product_desc: Amazon EC2 t3a.medium is a burstable general-purpose instance type offering a balance of compute, memory, and network resources, powered by AMD EPYC 7000 series processors. It provides a baseline level of CPU performance with the ability to burst CPU usage as needed.

product_features.Storage Controller: N/A (Managed by AWS Nitro System for EBS)
product_features.Network Interfaces: Up to 5 Gigabit network bandwidth, Enhanced Networking (ENA)
product_features.Remote Management: AWS Management Console, AWS CLI, SDKs, SSH/RDP
product_features.Security Features: AWS Nitro System, Nitro Security Chip, IAM, Security Groups, EBS Encryption
product_features.Management Software: AWS Management Console, AWS CLI, AWS SDKs
product_features.Special Features: Burstable performance with CPU Credits (Unlimited mode by default), powered by AWS Nitro System, EBS Optimized
